dataList.content:
<... Right, I think we can conclude our consultation session here.>
<……面谈差不多就到这里吧。>

I've been holding regular consultations with the Sinners for a while now.
这是周期性的罪人面谈环节。

My session with Heathcliff ended earlier than I'd expected.
与希斯克利夫的面谈结束得比我预料的更早一些。

<So... what are you writing in that notebook?>
<说来你在写什么？>

Oh, this?
啊，这个啊。

I thought writing 'em down could come in handy later. In case I have to remember something.
我只是觉得……多少做点记录有助于以后的记忆。

Heathcliff's been holding that notebook in his hands ever since this session started...
那是希斯克利夫自面谈开始便从不离手的笔记本。

It didn't seem like he was making a full record of our entire conversation; it was more like he was writing things down if they seemed worthy of remembering.
比起将我们的对话内容尽数记录，看起来更像是记录了需要留意的重点。

<Are you writing about... Catherine?>
<是关于……凯瑟琳的吗？>

Won't deny that that's a part of it.
也有那方面的部分。

His expression becomes inscrutably complex upon hearing her name; he breathes in a lungful of air and lets out a deep sigh.
听到凯瑟琳的名字，希斯克利夫以五味杂陈的表情缓缓地呼气。

He smiles awkwardly before sliding his notebook across the desk in my direction.
希斯克利夫略为尴尬地笑了笑，随后将他的笔记本递到了我的书桌上。

I take a quick glance at the pages. Its contents are as disorganized and chaotic as his handwriting...
我浏览过几页笔记，上面的内容有如希斯克利夫的字体一般一团乱麻。

But...
只不过……

I also notice that several of those disorganized notes are records of his memories with Catherine, scribbled next to notes of significant moments in our journey. Records of memories he doesn't want to lose.
我看得出来那些是他不愿遗忘的，与凯瑟琳之间的回忆……以及他作为罪人所经历的重大事件相关的记录。

... Well, it ain't nothing important.
……嘛，倒也没什么。

Right, if we're done here, I'm off.
总之，结束了我就先走了。

Heathcliff takes the notebook and leaves the room. I catch a glimpse of his bitter expression as he steps through the doorway.
一脸苦笑的希斯克利夫收拾起笔记本离开了我的房间……

... It isn't long before Rodya practically bursts through the door.
没过多久罗佳便推门而入了。

Hey, saw Heathcliff leaving the room just now and thought it was my turn. That was a pretty quick meeting, huh?
我看希斯出去了就直接进来了……面谈结束得还挺快？

<Yeah, we didn't really talk about much.>
<我们简单聊几句就结束了。>

I dunno what's gotten into him lately. He's been so... tame?
虽然不知道是怎么一回事，但最近希斯好像变老实了。

<Well, I'm not complaining... Why don't you take a seat, Rodya?>
<那挺好的……罗佳也坐下吧。>

Rodya hummed cheerfully as she sat down. She really didn't seem too different from her usual self.
哼着小曲坐到座位上的罗佳和平时没有太大区别。

Our 'consultations' usually consisted of some minor chitchat and watching her munch on some snacks, but...
虽然与罗佳之间的面谈往往通过闲聊以及我看着她吃零食的方式进行下去……

<Hey, so... I think there's something we have to talk about today.>
<今天我有些问题想问你。没关系吧？>

Y-yeah? Ooh, you're so serious today. What's up~?
搞什么啦，还把气氛搞这么正式~

<Do you remember what you asked me when we were dealing with the Case of Timekilling Time, Rodya?>
<在解决时间杀人时间的时候，你不是对我说过一些话么？>

... I dunno, what'd I say?
……我说了什么来着？

A *lot*.
倒也确实……说了很多话。

Rodya carefully looks away, her fingers fiddling with the snacks prepared for these consultations. I'm starting to grow uncertain whether this is a good time to bring this up when she's still so obviously evasive about it.
对着一边摆弄着书桌上的零食、一边悄悄避开我视线的罗佳，我拿不准到底该不该再次提出这个话题。

I really don't want the mood to get as frosty as it did during the investigation...
搞不好气氛又会像那时候一样冷淡……

... but this overly chipper, chatty attitude is just a bandage haphazardly pulled over a scar that still hurts, isn't it?
但是现在这副阳光开朗的模样……应该也不过是她临时隐藏伤疤的一种手段吧？

I sit there, looking at Rodya and her fabricated smile. I have to ask.
我注视着假装笑容的罗佳，做下了决定。

Yeah. This is exactly what these consultations are for. What better time to do this than now?
没错，这毕竟是面谈。这种事情此刻不说，更待何时？

<I'm talking about the time you asked me about Sonya. About what would've happened if you—>
<你在T公司的时候不是问过我吗？如果当时你跟着索尼亚……>

... The alarm had to choose this precise moment, when I finally gathered enough courage to bring this up... to go off.
……在我下定决心搬出这个话题的下一刻，刺耳的警报便沿着走廊传来。

<Wait, that was...!>
<刚刚的声音是……>

I reflexively get to my feet at the blaring alarm.
听到警报的我条件反射般站了起来。

A few seconds later, I hear someone tapping on the bus PA system.
紧接着，室内的音响传来了调试麦克风的声响。

And not long after that, a brief *bzzt* plays from the speaker installed in my room.
没过多久，室内的音响发出了短促的噪音。

Aa-ah. Aa-ah. Testing. Announcing from the driver's seat: all units taking R&R on the bus must assemble in the hallway ASAP.
啊啊。驾驶席播报。正在巴士中休息的所有人员前往走廊集合。

I repeat. All units taking R&R on the bus—
重复。正在巴士中休息的……

... Driver's seat, Charon's seat.
……驾驶席是卡戎的位子。

Augh, stop pulling me! I am in the process of relaying a very important announcement!
呃，别拽我！我正在通知重要事项！

Stop getting in the way between Charon and Mephi.
如果总在卡戎和梅菲之间插一脚的话，不好。

Haaah...
唉……

Vergilius' deep sigh was the last thing we heard from the bus' PA system before Charon and Outis' brief squabble came to an abrupt end.
音响中卡戎与奥提斯之间的争吵刚开始，立刻便由维吉里乌斯的叹息画下了句号。

My, a new Backdoors thingie? That's what the alarm usually means, right?
哎呀，看来刚刚的警报意味着后门又有新的变化了吧？

<Let's see... I'm gonna guess that this one's for a Refraction Railway...?>
<基于目前为止的规律的话……是折射轨道吧……>

Bleh, not a fan of those Railways. They're so exhausting...
呃呃，那个有点讨厌。那里头可太累人了……

Rodya grumbles for a moment before rising from her seat.
罗佳抱怨了片刻，自然而然站起了身。

Kinda seems like she's trying to smoothly maneuver away from answering my question...
虽然这也像是在自然地回避我的提问……

Whatcha standing around for, Dante? C'mon, aren'tcha going to see what's going on?
你怎么还傻站着，但丁？不去吗？

<Um... Yeah, I'm coming.>
<啊……当然去。>

I leave my empty consultation notes behind and follow Rodya out to the hallway.
我放下了尚未填写完毕的面谈记录表，跟着罗佳走了出去。

Out to a very crowded hallway.
刚打开房门，人满为患的走廊便映入眼帘。

The murmur rises and rises; the Sinners were each sharing their ideas as to what this alarm might be for.
他们好像是在交流意见，我越是靠近便越是喧闹。

I-it's got to be the Refraction Railway this time, right?
按、按顺序果然该轮到折射轨道了吧？

Yep. Line 4, most likely... huh. This is gonna suck, isn't it?
大概率是下一列的4号线了吧……呵。又要吃得苦中苦咯。

Atten-tion! The Executive Manager has arrived!
肃静。经理到场了！

Ahem. I have assembled your forces already in a timely manner.
咳，我率先一步集结了人员。

<T-thanks.>
<谢、谢谢你。>

Welcome, Dante.
您来了，但丁。

<I heard the radio... Is it a Refraction Railway this time?>
<我听到广播就直接过来了。……这次也是折射轨道吗？>

Yes. The fourth line of the Refraction Railway, to be exact.
是的。准确来说是折射轨道4号线。

Hey, I think they're getting used to this.
看来大伙也都快习惯了。

... W.T.H.A.W.G.I.
……到·时·进·里。

"Woe! 'Tis a Hearkening At—"
到达……时钟……？

"When... The Hell..."
到底什么时候……

It appears that she is requesting information pertinent to our schedule regarding our entry to the Railway.
好似是在询问到底何时前往内部。

To be exact, I think she's asking... "When the hell are we going in?"
准确来说她好像想知道到底什么时候进入里面。

Ryōshū, who had been listening with a knitted brow as each Sinner hazarded their guesses, appeared to have finally found peace.
在罪人们持续推测的过程中，眉头紧锁的良秀表情逐渐平和。

Sinclair was right on the money.
看来辛克莱说对了。

Hey, at least Gregor and Yi Sang got half of that right, too...
刚刚格里高尔和李箱好像也对了一半……

The bus alarms weren't the only things growing increasingly familiar to us. The Sinners were really getting to know one another as well.
不仅是巴士的警报，罪人们也在习惯更多的事物。

<Well, let's go check it out right now.>
<马上出发吧。>

Then I shall open the gates!
那么就由吾来开门！

The door opens with a creak, and a bright blue light fills my vision.
随着门扉开启的声响，蓝色的光芒充满了我的视野。
dataList.place:
Refraction Railway Platform
折射轨道 站台

dataList.content:
The blue ambiance almost seems to drop the temperature of the entire room.
这里填满了蓝色，给人一种冷冽的感觉。

Another Railway Line, completely different from Line 3 and its orange hue.
与充满了橙色的3号线相比，这里的空间截然不同。

Manager Esquire, behold! These curtains, these masks... I say, visions of par-tay lay before us, forsooth!
经理老爷！请看！帷幕配上假面……这简直就是派对！

<Masks?>
<假面？>

I follow Don Quixote, who had run off on her own again, with my eyes. It was as she said; the walls were lined with various masks, each wearing different expressions.
我的视线转向率先跑出去的堂吉诃德那边，随即看到墙上有许多表情丰富的假面。

I wonder if this has something to do with the theme of enemies we're about to meet here...
会与这次将要遭遇到的敌人有所关联吗……

Ooooh?! Hie thee hither, one and all! Here is a woman, her appearance a spitting image of Lady Outis!
哦哦哦？！各位快来这里看一看！有一位与奥提斯女士一模一样的人！

... What?
……什么？

There was urgency in her voice. I quickly ran to where Don Quixote was with the other Sinners in tow.
听到堂吉诃德略为急促的声音，我与其他罪人跑向了她的方位。

And there she was, an exact copy of Outis, standing before us.
那里真的站着一个和奥提斯一模一样的人。

... I hope this isn't anything serious...
……但愿这不是什么严峻事态。

Woah... she wasn't kidding.
天哪……居然是真的？

I-I hope this isn't a lure left behind by an Abnormality or something like that...
不、不会是异想体的诱饵之类的吧？

Oi. How about we don't tempt fate, lad?
喂，小不点。可别乌鸦嘴了。

Hm. But she's quiet, unlike Outis. And shrouded in a weird shadow.
但是她不像奥提斯女士一样会说话，而且看起来还有些暗淡？

Woaah~ Look, here's one that looks just like me~!
哇~这里还有和我长得一模一样的人呢~

Hong Lu stood next to a humanoid shape that mimicked every move he made.
鸿璐的身边有一个模仿着他的动作的人。

When he raised his hands, the shape raised its hands. When he closed his eyes, the shape closed its eyes.
一个鸿璐举起手就跟着举手，闭上眼就跟着闭眼的人……

Right, almost like a shadow with the darkness and its mimicry...
大概是因为色调与行为，他看起来就像个影子一样。

<Wait, that... that looks like one of Hong Lu's Identities.>
<那个……看起来好像是其他人格的鸿璐啊……>

I notice two, three more humanoid shadows standing nearby.
除此之外，不远处好像还能瞅见两三个人影。

What on earth is going on?
到底是怎么回事？

We'd be much better off if they were some byproduct of an Abnormality. However, if they are clones...
如果是异想体的话还算走运，但万一是出于某种原因产生的复制人的话……

We must move swiftly to exterminate them, Executive Manager.
经理，我们必须争分夺秒地除掉他们。

I request that you immediately order us to prepare for battle.
现在请立刻下达战斗指令。

<Gimme a sec, I'll ask Faust first if—>
<稍等，先咨询一下浮士德……>

No! You must make a judgment call at this instant! If they are indeed clones, then the Head will—!
请您务必当机立断！万一他们真的是复制人的话，首脑会……

This isn't the first time she's asked to make a decision like this, but...
虽然我已经不止一次听过奥提斯让我做出决定的话语……

... she's never been this serious or adamant about it before.
但是这么严肃的表情和坚决的语气还是第一次。

Yi Sang noticed the tension and quickly stepped in between the two of us.
李箱好像注意到了这一点，走到了我和奥提斯之间。

Miss Faust... would you kindly share what you know of this phenomenon?
浮士德女士……能请你说明一下吗？

Yes. This entity is not a clone.
当然。这些个体并非复制人。

Therefore, even if a week were to pass, the Head will not mobilize.
所以即便一周过后首脑也不会动手。

Faust nodded sagely as though she had just learned something new, before looking in my direction.
说到这里，浮士德好似得知了某种新的情报一般点了点头，随后便只是看向了我。

Right, she probably wants me to explain what this is. I quickly blurted out the first thing that came to my mind.
她的表情似乎是在要求我作出说明，我赶紧向奥提斯说道。

<... That one feels like a Peccatulum.>
<……那个好像是罪种……>

... I wasn't completely sure, but that's the feeling I've so grown used to sensing whenever we encountered the Peccatula.
……虽然无法确信，但那确实是与我一直以来所感受到的罪种相差无几的感觉。

A Peccatulum...
罪种……

It's blindly mimicking whatever Hong Lu is doing. I'm not sure if it has much, or anything, in the way of consciousness or ego. It doesn't look like a one-to-one copy of him, either.
就凭它只是模仿鸿璐先生的动作这一点来看，自我恐怕十分稀薄。外观上也有所不同。

Please becalm yourself, Miss Outis. It appears that aught has unnerved you.
请冷静，奥提斯女士。你好像过于激动了。

Outis bows, embarrassment apparent but her head cleared with relief.
大概是头脑冷静了下来，奥提斯以一种混杂着安心与羞耻的态度弯下了腰。

My deepest apologies, Executive Manager. I should not have acted in such an unsightly manner before you.
十分抱歉，竟然在经理面前露出这般丑态……

Clearly, I still have a lot to learn about the Sinners. Every instance of these moments seem to unveil something new.
每当我更进一步了解罪人们的时候，经常又会见到他们不为人知的一面。

I was trying to get a better read on Outis' expression when Heathcliff suddenly asked a question out loud.
正当我打算仔细打量奥提斯的表情时，希斯克利夫提出了问题。

Uh... I thought them 'Peccatula' are supposed to look like monsters, innit?
呃……但是那些叫罪种的不是更、那啥，长得像怪物一样吗？

Distortions and the Peccatula must not be judged on a reference based on 'common sense', such as their physical appearance.
不论是扭曲还是罪种……都不可以用外观之类的常识对待。

B-but do you think we can handle them?
但、但应该是我们能够匹敌的那种水准的罪种吧……？

Oh, yeah. If they're going to swarm us like they did at the manor, or if they manage to somehow copy Vergilius... that's going to be a problem.
啊，确实。如果像是在宅邸里那样涌过来，或者是变成维吉里乌斯先生的话会很棘手。

Recall the Railways of Refraction we have suffered ere this one's arrival. It should not present before us a foe we cannot defeat. Yet the process shall be as grueling as it always has been, I suspect.
回首迄今为止的折射轨道，我认为从未面对过不可战胜的对手。只不过，过程颇为坎坷。

Faust is aware that this entity is a Peccatulum of Envy... Peccatulum Invidiae. Considering the strengths of the Peccatula we have faced thus far, it is unlikely that we will encounter enemies too far beyond our ability to defeat.
浮士德知道这是嫉妒罪种。结合目前为止的罪种考虑，应该不会存在无法与之战斗的战力差距。

Mm. The lack of precise tiered labeling system means that it is difficult for one to make a subjective judgment.
嗯。尚未以正确的评级标记罪种，可供自行判断的情报减少。

Speaking of which, what's the ETA on the new Risk Levels and Classifications for the Peccatula and Distortions?
说来罪种和扭曲的危险等级调整现在如何了？

The LCD has informed us that they have made significant progress regarding that project. It is likely that further details will be shared once they become more concrete.
LCD部门虽然尚未完成，但据告知已颇有进展。只要日程确定下来就可以告知我们了。

Ah, that's good to know~
那可真是太好了~

Oops! Looks like the Peccatula are running away all of a sudden.
啊！但是那些罪种好像突然就开始逃跑了？

As we stood there talking to one another, a Peccatulum that resembles Hong Lu suddenly shoved him to the side and began sprinting elsewhere.
谈话期间，形似鸿璐的罪种突然推开鸿璐并开始奔向某处。

What the hell, mate?! Don't just sit there and gawk at 'em when they're all leggin' it!
卧槽！别傻愣着啊！

Heathcliff also sprinted after the figure, but he soon came to a sudden stop before starting to slowly back away.
虽然希斯克利夫追了过去，但他不知看到了什么，突然停步并向后退去。

Oh, blimey...
真是疯了……

A subway train slides into the platform with a loud horn.
随着一声烦人的鸣笛声，电车正在驶入站台。

Past the windows I see... a subway car filled to the brim with purple shadows.
透过那扇窗，我看到了密密麻麻的紫色影子。

... Shadows in the shape of the Sinners.
……它们全都与罪人们长得一模一样。

Huh... That's... that's a lot of 'em.
哈，那到底……有多少人啊？

Ugh... I think I recognized like three shadows that look just like me...
呃……我好像看到了三个和我长相一致的人……

That ridiculous sight was enough to stop us all dead in our tracks, allowing the Peccatulum to board the subway car...
我和罪人们都在这惊人的一幕中停下了脚步，而奔跑的罪种则乘上了电车……

And the door shut behind him.
车门随即关闭。

I sense... aught in the way of disquietude from this Refraction Railway.
此次折射轨道……亦非同寻常。

Fellas, there's another one coming this way!
哦哦……！那边好像又开过来一列？

As soon as the subway train carrying the Peccatula leave the station, a new one begins to roll in.
罪种们所搭乘的电车离站没多久，一列新的电车开始入站。

To my relief, this one doesn't look like it's packed to the brim with shadow people.
所幸的是上面没有像上一列那样满载着影子人。

<But... what is that?>
<但是……那是什么？>

<There are curtains, and... masks? I don't remember seeing anything like that on the last Railways we challenged.>
<好像……挂着类似帷幕的东西，那个是……假面吗？之前的折射轨道可没这些东西……>

How uninspired.
平平无奇的艺术。

Hey, I didn't notice it earlier 'cuz of all that mess with clones and everything, but... doesn't that train look much more elaborate than what we've seen before?
刚刚有点慌张没能好好观察，但这电车的装饰……还挺华丽的不是吗？

Right~ It's adorned with all kinds of decorations.
是这样呢~还挂着一串串的饰品。

Just as the Sinners were gawking at the ostentatiousness that was this train, something burst forth from the train car door.
正当几名罪人正在对着新的电车感叹不已的时候，从停稳的电车门中突然弹出了什么东西。

Aah-woagh! H-huh, did that thing just roll out a carpet for us...?
呃……呃啊啊！哎、哎呀？这个是地毯吧……？

<It's like something's inviting us in there...>
<仿佛是在邀请我们。>

I ill like such manner of invitation...
此等邀请，颇不招人喜欢。

I agreed with Yi Sang. This isn't an invitation I'm happy to jump at, but...
确实是如李箱所说不招人喜欢的邀请……

... I'm sure we'll face even worse things in our journey. I'll take every chance we get to strengthen the Sinners.
但是想到未来的旅程，我不能错过使罪人变强的机会。

<... Let's go.>
<……走吧。>

I took my first steps onto the carpet...
我带头踏上了铺在地板上的地毯……

... and boarded the subway train.
与罪人们一起搭上了电车。
